rows.ja: 半導体メーカー(仕入先)

relations.text: NXPの年次報告が、同社の主要な流通パートナー5社の1つとしてAvnetを挙げている
relations.text_en: NXP's annual report lists Avnet among its five largest distribution partners

source.label: NXP Semiconductors 10-K
source.quote: We also have a strong position with our distribution partners, including our five largest in alphabetical order, Arrow, Avnet, Nexty, WT Micro and World Peace.

relations.text: NXPの年次報告によると、Avnetは2025年のNXPの売上の23%(2024年は22%)を占めた
relations.text_en: NXP's annual report says Avnet accounted for 23% of its revenue in 2025 and 22% in 2024

source.label: NXP Semiconductors 10-K
source.quote: Avnet accounted for 23% of our revenue in 2025 and 22% in 2024.

companies.name: バンク・オブ・アメリカ

relations.text: AvnetはBank of America, N.A.を管理代理人とするクレジット契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: Avnet entered into a Credit Agreement with Bank of America, N.A. as administrative agent

source.label: Avnet 10-K
source.quote: (“Avnet”), as borrower, entered into a Credit Agreement (the “Credit Agreement”) with the lenders party thereto and Bank of America, N.A., as administrative agent.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: Avnetは2026年8月12日付でBank of America, N.A.を管理代理人とするクレジット契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: Avnet has a Credit Agreement dated as of August 12, 2026 with Bank of America, N.A. as administrative agent

source.label: Avnet 10-K
source.quote: Credit Agreement dated as of August 12, 2026, among Avnet, Inc., as borrower, Bank of America, N.A., as administrative agent, and each lender party thereto.

relations.text: Avnetは、Wells Fargo Bank, N.A.を代理人とする売掛債権購入契約(2018年8月16日付)を結んでいる
relations.text_en: Avnet is party to a Receivables Purchase Agreement dated August 16, 2018 with Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. as agent

source.label: Avnet 10-K
source.quote: (1) Fourth Amended and Restated Receivables Purchase Agreement, dated August 16, 2018, among Avnet, Inc., Avnet Receivables Corporation, the companies and financial institutions party thereto and Wells Fargo Bank, N.A., as agent (incorporated herein by reference to Exhibit 10.1 to the Company’s Current Report on Form 8-K filed on August 17, 2018).
source.note: 過去の契約書の記載で、資金調達のみの関係です。
source.note_en: Older exhibit listing; financing relationship only.

relations.text: 同じく、Wells Fargo Bank, N.A.を代理人とする売掛債権購入契約(2020年2月28日付)がある
relations.text_en: A further Receivables Purchase Agreement dated February 28, 2020 names Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. as agent

source.label: Avnet 10-K
source.quote: Receivables Purchase Agreement, dated February 28, 2020, among Avnet, Inc., Avnet Receivables Corporation, the companies and financial institutions party thereto and Wells Fargo Bank, N.A., as agent (incorporated herein by reference to Exhibit 10.1 to the Company’s Annual Report on Form 10-Q filed on May 1, 2020).

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
